concerns.text: Spec FR-007 requires Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction, but the plan implements Bonferroni correction (see FR/SC Coverage Matrix row for FR‑007). This diverges from the functional requirement and needs either the spec to be updated or the plan to implement BH as specified.

Spec FR-010 mandates a minimum subject count of N ≥ 50 before analysis, whereas the plan validates N ≥ 30 (see FR‑010 description in the matrix). The lower threshold does not satisfy the functional requirement.
